@overview 字彙王 Level 3–5 練習題本。答案與中文詞義已與教材官方解答逐題核對；題目文字為照片轉錄。

@group A 文意字彙（1–5）：依提示寫出正確的字

Q 1 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: It is d______l that we will arrive on time, since now we are stuck in a traffic jam.
= doubtful
~詞義 doubtful（adj.）無法確定的
~原文 It is doubtful that we will arrive on time, since now we are stuck in a traffic jam.

Q 2 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The concert will be p______ed until next week owing to the typhoon.
= postponed
~詞義 postpone（v.）延後
~原文 The concert will be postponed until next week owing to the typhoon.

Q 3 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: This chef usually r______ts the meat over hot coals for several hours to make it tender.
= roasts
~詞義 roast（v.）炙烤
~原文 This chef usually roasts the meat over hot coals for several hours to make it tender.

Q 4 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The mother can have a rest now that her baby has finally fallen asleep in the c______e.
= cradle
~詞義 cradle（n.）搖籃
~原文 The mother can have a rest now that her baby has finally fallen asleep in the cradle.

Q 5 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The farm dogs are chasing a f______k of sheep, forcing them to return home.
= flock
~詞義 flock（n.）群
~原文 The farm dogs are chasing a flock of sheep, forcing them to return home.

@group B 選擇題（6–10）

Q 6 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Even though the boy had done something wrong, his mother didn't punish him because she appreciated his ______.
A: misery
B: portion
C: lottery
D: honesty
= D
~詞義 honesty（n.）誠實
~原文 Even though the boy had done something wrong, his mother didn't punish him because she appreciated his honesty.

Q 7 | choice | 選擇題
stem: This ______ tea set is a valuable treasure to my family.
A: buffalo
B: porcelain
C: portrait
D: sausage
= B
~詞義 porcelain（n.）瓷器
~原文 This porcelain tea set is a valuable treasure to my family.

Q 8 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The museum displayed a ______ ancient box whose purpose no historian has been able to explain.
A: mysterious
B: stubborn
C: vigorous
D: mature
= A
~詞義 mysterious（adj.）神祕的
~原文 The museum displayed a mysterious ancient box whose purpose no historian has been able to explain.

Q 9 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Following the outbreak of World War II, many people in Europe lived in ______ for years.
A: lottery
B: sausage
C: pottery
D: misery
= D
~詞義 misery（n.）悲慘
~原文 Following the outbreak of World War II, many people in Europe lived in misery for years.

Q 10 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Luke grabbed a cloth to ______ off the muddy footprints his dog had left all over the floor.
A: wipe
B: boast
C: float
D: crawl
= A
~詞義 wipe（v.）擦拭
~原文 Luke grabbed a cloth to wipe off the muddy footprints his dog had left all over the floor.

@group C 配合題（11–15）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: portions
B: grasped
C: miserable
D: crashed
E: lively
F: automobiles

Q 11 | bank | 配合題
stem: Exhaust from ______ contains gasses that contribute to global warming.
= F
~詞義 automobile（n.）汽車
~原文 Exhaust from automobiles contains gasses that contribute to global warming.

Q 12 | bank | 配合題
stem: The car ______ straight into the tree, but luckily the driver wasn't seriously injured.
= D
~詞義 crash（v.）猛烈撞上
~原文 The car crashed straight into the tree, but luckily the driver wasn't seriously injured.

Q 13 | bank | 配合題
stem: To make more money, the businessman ______ every opportunity to expand his business.
= B
~詞義 grasp（v.）抓住
~原文 To make more money, the businessman grasped every opportunity to expand his business.

Q 14 | bank | 配合題
stem: Many children like the picture book because the story is ______ and interesting.
= E
~詞義 lively（adj.）生動活潑的
~原文 Many children like the picture book because the story is lively and interesting.

Q 15 | bank | 配合題
stem: Because of the war, the kid lost his parents and then lived a(n) ______ life.
= C
~詞義 miserable（adj.）悲慘的
~原文 Because of the war, the kid lost his parents and then lived a(n) miserable life.

@group C 配合題（16–20）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: poured
B: mature
C: skeptical
D: ripe
E: roared
F: portrayed

Q 16 | bank | 配合題
stem: Larry ______ all the milk into his coffee, but it still tasted very bitter.
= A
~詞義 pour（v.）倒
~原文 Larry poured all the milk into his coffee, but it still tasted very bitter.

Q 17 | bank | 配合題
stem: The audience grew ______ about the speaker's claims when he refused to provide any evidence.
= C
~詞義 skeptical（adj.）懷疑的
~原文 The audience grew skeptical about the speaker's claims when he refused to provide any evidence.

Q 18 | bank | 配合題
stem: The young man is ______ enough to make decisions by himself.
= B
~詞義 mature（adj.）(身心上)成熟的
~原文 The young man is mature enough to make decisions by himself.

Q 19 | bank | 配合題
stem: When the lion ______, the wolves ran away.
= E
~詞義 roar（v.）吼叫
~原文 When the lion roared, the wolves ran away.

Q 20 | bank | 配合題
stem: The article ______ the athlete as hardworking and determined, describing the long journey behind her success.
= F
~詞義 portray（v.）描繪
~原文 The article portrayed the athlete as hardworking and determined, describing the long journey behind her success.
